dedupe_keys.name: anrsc performance analysis of romanian water and wastewater operators regulated benchmarking 2025 report

description: ANRSC, Romania's regulator of community public utility services, produces an annual analysis of the performance of Romanian water and wastewater operators from its regulated benchmarking programme, whose data the operators report through a dedicated portal (the 2025 report is the fourth round). The 43-page 2025 report covers access to water supply and sewerage, service quality, operational and economic efficiency and investment across eight performance areas, network and plant totals for the reporting operators (for example 84,836 km of distribution network, 17,323 km of transmission mains, 998 treatment stations and 5,746 pumping stations), the effects of economic regulation on business plans, water losses, energy efficiency and wastewater directive compliance, and annexes with indicators and recommendations for 47 major regional and large municipal operators. Coverage is Romania's water and wastewater operators, including small local operators. The report is a free PDF download from anrsc.ro; no licence is stated. Caveats: the results are published as a PDF report, not a data table, and ANRSC notes that the quality of reported data is still improving from one round to the next. Simulation uses: operator-level network length, losses, energy use and investment for capacity planning and resilience baselines of Romanian water services. Related records: the French water services observatory SISPEA (data-sispea-french-water-services-observatory).
